deploy-bot: Deploy finished: prod v2026.03.21-rc7. Post-deploy synth job `smoke-lab` scheduled (fanout=50). Owner: @liam
liam: kicking off quick synth + smoke. Focus: /embed route + webhook fanout. Will stream results here.
qa-bot: smoke-lab results start:
- sample 50 requests across 5 regions
- 4 regions returned 50/50 OK
- apac3 returned 30/50 OK, 20/50 429-like errors (rate limited)
summary: 20/50 429s from apac3, affected route: /embed (fanout endpoint)
rachel: seeing the same in observability 10m spike in 429s, circuit-breaker in runtime tripped earlier today but threshold looks lower on new build. Could be the change to per-request batching.
ops-sre: quick questions: do we want to pin the old model variant for apac3, or reduce probe fanout? We can also add a temporary routing rule to send synth traffic to eu1 shadow pool.
liam: prefer to avoid pinning for the release. Let's reduce probe fanout from 50 -> 10 for apac3 and divert the rest to shadow eu1. That buys time to investigate. Can ops add a deploybot route override for synth-lab?
ops-sre: on it. I'll add a temporary routing rule: `route.override(synth-lab).region(apac3)->shadow:eu1; fanout=10` and throttle synth to 5rps. Applying now.
qa-bot: new run queued (fanout adjusted). Results: apac3 10/10 OK after diversion. No more 429s observed in production metrics for /embed.
rachel: digging into logs: runtime circuit-breaker metrics show per-pod borrow_count spikes when fanout>20. The recent optimization reduced per-request concurrency buffer which lowered CB threshold. We should revert that micro-optimization or tune the threshold.
liam: agree. For now, leave the synth diversion in place and add a rollback candidate to the release notes in case we see a wider regression. Also creating INF-3302 to add a startup probe for embed fanout capacity and to add hysteresis to synth runs.
ops-sre: diversion applied and annotated in release metadata. Will schedule a non-disruptive config tweak to increase circuit-breaker threshold by +25% for apac3 tomorrow low-traffic window (03:00 UTC) if tests look stable.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy synth check: PARTIAL_PASS (apac3 diverted). Metadata: {"release":"v2026.03.21-rc7","synth":"smoke-lab","owner":"liam","diversion":"eu1-shadow"} :white_check_mark:
liam: updating release notes: "Reduced synth fanout for apac3 and diverted excess to eu1 shadow due to transient circuit-breaker sensitivity; follow-up INF-3302." Will flip synth-lab back once cb threshold fix is live.
ops-sre: leaving watch on the routing override for 30m, will remove diversion if stable. ping me if anything else. :eyes:
liam: thanks everyone. Filing follow-up and closing thread for now.
